why: [atc] alert_level_incident = [3]: an alert level 2 is a pre-alert pushed at priority 5 but makes no incident; the upgrade to 3 makes the queued incident.

text: 60 Control, car 9901, declaring an alert level 2 for a Citation, runway 34
60 Control, car 9901, upgrade to an alert level 3, the aircraft is now reporting smoke
